row.name: Car-Controller-Getx-Flutter
row.description: A user-friendly car control dashboard built using Flutter and powered by GetX for efficient state management. Enjoy a modern and intuitive design that adapts to various screen sizes. Interact with dynamic car controls, including a controls and temprature. Realistic animations enhance the visual appeal.
